themeHint: Pick a look that feels right for you — light, dark, or maximum readability.

advisoryHint: Auto-generated guidance for your crops from live weather conditions.
advisoryHumidity: High humidity ({{humidity}}%) — watch for fungal diseases like blight and rust. Avoid evening overhead irrigation.
advisoryRainChance: Rain likely ({{prob}}%) — delay pesticide/fertilizer spraying; harvest dry crops early.
advisoryWind: Strong winds ({{wind}} km/h) — avoid spraying to prevent pesticide drift.
advisoryUv: High UV ({{uv}}) — heat stress risk for young seedlings; irrigate in cooler hours.
advisoryHeat: Very hot ({{temp}}°C) — irrigate early morning and mulch to keep soil moisture.
advisoryCold: Cold ({{temp}}°C) — protect young plants from frost with light mulch or covers.
advisoryDew: High dew point ({{dew}}°C) — morning dew favors rust; scout wheat and paddy for pustules.
advisoryFine: Conditions are favorable for routine field work — spraying and irrigation are safe.
